name: Chikan-san Taiken Tour ~Densha Hen~
original_name: 痴漢さん体験ツアー～電車編～
source:
One day, you received an invitation letter for some sort of orientation. Few days later, you catch a train to participate in the orientation.... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE026584.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
某天，你收到一封參加某種說明會的邀請函。幾天後，你乘上火車前往說明會……

[來源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE026584.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
